company.name: OneTrust
company.shortDescription: OneTrust is the AI-Ready Governance platform helping organizations accelerate innovation while ensuring responsible data use.
company.description: OneTrust is the leading platform for responsible data and AI use. Headquartered in Atlanta with global offices, OneTrust helps organizations simplify consent and preference management, automate governance across privacy, security, IT, third-party, and AI risk, and enforce policies throughout the data lifecycle. The platform unites data and risk teams to drive trusted innovation. OneTrust holds more than 300 patents and serves over 14,000 customers worldwide, including Fortune 500 companies and small businesses, across industries such as financial services, healthcare, and technology.

aiResearchSummary.text: OneTrust is researching systems for detecting violations of data policies via dynamic classification of digital content, managing implementation of data controls for computing systems, and utilizing a large language model to modify digital data of an entity in response to system requirements frameworks. It is also developing data processing systems and methods for performing assessments and monitoring through privacy-related data maps. Together these efforts target automated data governance, privacy compliance, and AI driven control of data handling.
